question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The incorrect spelling here is 'Hygene'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

We have to choose an erroneously spelled word as our correct answer.

 
• The spelling of Bouquet is correct and hence it is not our chosen answer.
 
• The spelling of Mortgage is correct and hence it is not our chosen answer.
 
• The spelling of Champagne is correct and hence it is not our chosen answer.
 
• Therefore, the correct option is option 2 and the correct spelling is 'Hygiene'.
